title: Longest window of distinct hosts
hints: Pattern: sliding window. Keep a start index and grow the end one element at a time; when the window breaks the rule, move start forward just enough to fix it.
A dict from host to the index where it was last seen tells you, in O(1), whether the current host is already inside the window.
Only move start when last_seen[host] >= start; a repeat that is behind the window must be ignored (test with 'abbac').
After updating last_seen and start, the window length is i - start + 1; keep the maximum.
